c.c:
Alex Hawk stepped through a door into time.

He emerged into a distant future that looked like Earth's past, with tribes of giant warriors and strange and massive creatures. 

All Alex wants is to get back to his daughter Amy.
First, he must fulfill an oath and find the kidnapped young girl the tribe believes is the answer to an ancient prophecy. 

Alex and his mighty dog will pursue the kidnappers across the strange and fantastical landscape of Kragdon-ah. He will fight ever-more unbelievable creatures and the most dangerous animal of all - man.
